correctness.rationale: Independent uniform binary digits and a stationary geometric reflected level give an exact decomposition of every covariance into ordinary and half-weighted birth–death kernels. Two explicit Poisson solutions satisfy both interior and boundary equations; reversible Jacobi spectral gaps justify summation. Substitution of exact geometric moments yields the rational Green–Kubo function, whose critical value is four while the one-time variance decays linearly. The standalone rational checker passed all 182 coefficient comparisons and exact Poisson identities; it is corroboration rather than a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The exact coefficient quantifies long-time fluctuations and integrated correlation near the published critical intermittency transition. It exhibits a mathematically motivated noncommutation: equilibrium becomes a point mass and instantaneous variance tends to zero, but its stationary partial-sum variance stays finite and approaches four; the normalized integrated time diverges at an exact rate. This is a natural singular dynamical invariant, not an arbitrary parameter sample.
